privacy_section_1_desc: Welcome to VIEproduct. We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This privacy policy will inform you as to how we look after your personal data when you visit our website (regardless of where you visit it from) and tell you about your privacy rights and how the law protects you.
privacy_section_2_title: The Data We Collect About You
privacy_section_2_desc_1: Personal data, or personal information, means any information about an individual from which that person can be identified. It does not include data where the identity has been removed (anonymous data).
privacy_section_2_desc_2: We may collect, use, store and transfer different kinds of personal data about you which we have grouped together as follows:
identity_data_desc: includes first name, last name, username or similar identifier, title, date of birth and gender.
contact_data_desc: includes billing address, delivery address, email address and telephone numbers.
financial_data_desc: includes bank account and payment card details.
transaction_data_desc: includes details about payments to and from you and other details of products and services you have purchased from us.
technical_data_desc: includes internet protocol (IP) address, your login data, browser type and version, time zone setting and location, browser plug-in types and versions, operating system and platform, and other technology on the devices you use to access this website.
privacy_section_3_title: How We Use Your Personal Data
privacy_section_3_desc: We will only use your personal data when the law allows us to. Most commonly, we will use your personal data in the following circumstances:
privacy_section_3_point_1: Where we need to perform the contract we are about to enter into or have entered into with you.
privacy_section_3_point_2: Where it is necessary for our legitimate interests (or those of a third party) and your interests and fundamental rights do not override those interests.
privacy_section_3_point_3: Where we need to comply with a legal obligation.
privacy_section_4_desc: We have put in place appropriate security measures to prevent your personal data from being accidentally lost, used or accessed in an unauthorized way, altered or disclosed. In addition, we limit access to your personal data to those employees, agents, contractors and other third parties who have a business need to know.
privacy_section_5_desc: Under certain circumstances, you have rights under data protection laws in relation to your personal data, including the right to request access, correction, erasure, restriction, transfer, to object to processing, to portability of data and to automated decision making.

faq_q1: How do I verify the credibility of a manufacturer?
faq_a1: Look for the 'Verified' badge on the manufacturer's profile. This confirms they have provided business certifications and have been verified by the system. You can view certifications directly on the supplier's profile page.
faq_q2: What is a Request for Quotation (RFQ) and how do I use it?
faq_a2: An RFQ (Request for Quotation) allows you to post a purchasing request so suppliers can submit competitive quotes. Go to the RFQ page, enter the product information you need, quantity, and delivery timeline.
faq_q3: How do I scan a QR code to verify authentic products?
faq_a3: Visit the Verify page (/verify), enter the product code or scan the QR with your camera. The system will display product information, production batch, expiry date, and warnings if the code has been scanned abnormally.
faq_a4: No, VIEProduct is completely free for both Buyers and Suppliers. You can register with email or sign in quickly with Google.
faq_q5: Will newly posted products be displayed immediately?
faq_a5: No, new products will be in 'Pending' status. Admin will review and approve as soon as possible. Once approved, the product will be publicly visible on the products page.
